rules.sentence: Unlike Ewing sarcoma, spindling of tumor cells is seen with small-cell osteosarcoma.[24]
A minuscule volume of an osteoid matrix also distinguishes this as a variant of osteosarcoma.[24]
Parosteal osteosarcoma accounts for <4% of osteosarcomas and occurs on the posterior distal femur in 75% to 80% of cases.[24]
A histopathological exam demonstrates “streamers of bone trabeculae” running in parallel and cellular fibrous tissue.[24]
Immunohistochemical analysis shows both CDK4 and MDM2 amplification in a majority of parosteal osteosarcomas.[22]
